definitions.accepted_for_internal_testing: The project owner accepted the internal evidence package. No customer acceptance is claimed.
definitions.achievement_record: A limited statement about what was completed, linked to exact repository evidence and factuality boundaries.
definitions.complete_internal_file_set: All files required by this internal test were generated. It does not mean the product or service is complete.
definitions.withheld_topic: A capability that remains visible but is deliberately not claimed because supporting evidence is missing.

not_allowed_now: Writes to source or target repositories
not_verified: The video flow runs end to end.
Japanese transcription accuracy meets any target.
The video flow is production ready.
The report product creates customer value, revenue, or commercial results.
The workflow works for arbitrary repositories.
verified_now: The workflow generated the required internal files twice with matching fingerprints.
For seminar-compass, six bounded achievement statements are linked to seven eligible merged pull requests.
For rts-video-flow, two bounded achievement statements are linked to merged pull requests #1 and #2.
The rts-video-flow package visibly keeps three unsupported runtime topics in the Not verified section.

reader_takeaway: The internal workflow can preserve both positive evidence and missing-evidence limits. The next proof needed is a structurally different third public case, followed by privacy-adversarial and operating-metric tests.
title: What the internal evidence-report workflow has and has not proved
